full_text: This is what I now have to wear at a golf tournament in 87 degrees and a pandemic. #covid19 #facemask #hothothot @ Springdale, Arkansas https://t.co/0FHWb0mQAY

location_description: Springdale is the fourth-largest city in Arkansas, United States. It is located in both Washington and Benton counties in Northwest Arkansas. Located on the Springfield Plateau deep in the Ozark Mountains, Springdale has long been an important industrial city for the region.
